title: Slovakian-Style Skillet Schnitzel
description: A German-inspired dish featuring breaded and pan-fried pork cutlets, served with crispy Slovakian-style sunflower seeds.
instructions: 1. In a food processor, blend breadcrumbs from Slovakian bread until fine.
2. In a shallow dish, mix together breadcrumbs, lacto-free milk, and a pinch of salt.
3. Dredge each pork cutlet in the breadcrumb mixture, pressing gently to adhere.
4. Heat 1/4 cup of vegetable oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
5. Pan-fry pork cutlets for 2-3 minutes per side, or until golden brown and cooked through.
6. Transfer pork cutlets to a plate and let rest for a few minutes.
7. Meanwhile, toast sunflower seeds in a dry skillet over medium heat, stirring frequently.
8. Serve each pork cutlet with a dollop of sour cream and a sprinkle of toasted sunflower seeds.
